mapper.select: SELECT c.command_id, c.state, c.payload_json, e.fact_line_id AS line_id, l.order_id, l.sku_id, l.base_unit, o.owner_id FROM source_command c JOIN source_effect e ON e.id=c.business_effect_key AND e.enterprise_id=c.enterprise_id AND e.warehouse_id=c.warehouse_id AND e.action=c.action JOIN inbound_line l ON l.id=e.fact_line_id AND l.enterprise_id=c.enterprise_id AND l.warehouse_id=c.warehouse_id JOIN inbound_order o ON o.id=l.order_id AND o.enterprise_id=l.enterprise_id AND o.warehouse_id=l.warehouse_id WHERE c.enterprise_id=#{ent} AND c.warehouse_id=#{wh} AND c.command_id=#{receipt} AND c.action='RECEIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbound_receipt_quality (id,enterprise_id,warehouse_id,receipt_command_id,inbound_line_id,state,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{id},#{ent},#{wh},#{receipt},#{line},'OPEN',#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT id,receipt_command_id,inbound_line_id,source_version,applied_version,accepted_qty,rejected_qty, putaway_qty,active_command_id,state,version FROM inbound_receipt_quality WHERE enterprise_id=#{ent} AND warehouse_id=#{wh} AND receipt_command_id=#{receipt} FOR UPDATE
